beats.text: Five Stoic lessons on building a life of purpose.
One. Decide what kind of person you want to be — then act the part, today, not someday.
Two. Keep death in view. Nothing clears away the trivial like remembering your time is finite.
Three. Be useful. A life spent serving something beyond yourself rarely feels empty.
Four. Fall in love with the process, not the applause. Do the work for the work's own sake.
Five. Live in agreement with your nature — your reason, your role, your deepest values.
Purpose isn't something you find lying around. It's something you build, one aligned action at a time.
